name: tracker-refused-flag-delivery
goal: A tighter tracker flag contract never silently drops a machine alert: monitors have 'tracker alert', every refused flag is kept for Chief of Staff, and unattended callers are contract-tested

evidence: Brief ksyxq7: since the structured-flag rule the CLI refuses a legacy 'tracker flag <id> <msg>' before it reaches the service; monitors that discard stderr lose every alert. Reproduced by running the strengthened CLI tests on 7b36a973a2. Expected: a supported alert verb, every refused flag kept on its item or the CoS inbox, unattended caller shapes contract-tested.

tracker-flag-structured.test.ts only asserted that nativeTrackerArgs throws; it never ran the CLI against the item API, never asserted what happens to the refused message, and held no unattended caller argument shapes. Gap closed with a shared real-CLI channel fixture and a caller inventory fixture.
Committed tests fail on unchanged product code: 9 failed, 23 passed; assertion: expected the CLI output to contain 'kept for Chief of Staff'.

tracker alert verb; refused flags (parser or service refusal) kept on the item and CoS inbox; inbox messages survive finished or unknown targets and are sent first; unattended caller inventory contract test.
loop record --phase green passed at the separate fix commit with unchanged tests.
